class.name: SteamDlcProgressResult
class.brief_description: Outcome of a Steam DLC download progress query.
class.description: Returned by [method SteamApps.download_progress]. An inactive download is a successful query with an inactive snapshot.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the detached progress snapshot on success, or [code]null[/code] on error.

members.member: Read-only progress snapshot for a successful query. An error result has a [code]null[/code] payload.
